description:
Welcome to the official Root & Canopy channel!

Witness the hidden time-lapse warfare of plants—from dormant seed to 2,000-year canopy giant.
Clear, visual, research-backed 2D hand-drawn explainers crafted for Nature documentary enthusiasts, botanical science fans, and viewers fascinated by time-lapse life cycles.

Core topics: Plant evolution through deep time, seed-to-giant life-cycle time-lapses & botanical warfare.

#botany #plants #timelapse #evolution #naturedocumentary #lifecycle
keywords: Plant evolution through deep time, seed-to-giant life-cycle time-lapses & botanical warfare
